connector.name: Budgetary: estimate token spend
connector.registryDescription: Pre-flight, probabilistic token-spend estimate (range, scenario, confidence) for a coding task.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.budgetary.tools over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the thriftell account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
